name: io.github.usama-saeed831/plesk-deploy-mcp
title: Plesk Deploy
description: Safe, approval-gated Plesk deployments: inspect, generate and validate a kit; status, logs, rollback

environmentVariables.name: PLESK_DEPLOY_SSH_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ~/.ssh/config host aliases the SSH tools may reach. Unset: the SSH tools are off.

environmentVariables.name: PLESK_DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional read-only fine-grained token (Actions: read) for github_deploy_runs on private repositories.
